_comment: pumex-helper vs the MERGED endpoint (2a5ef57), which serves all five source
indexers at once. Run with --entity-prefix Helper_ so subgraph `Gauge`
resolves to `Helper_Gauge`, and with --chain <id> so ids are prefix-filtered
Four chains, four subgraphs, four schema files:
lynex-helper carries only 11 of the 26 Helper_ types: the ve/points family
(VeLock, VeToken, VeTokenSnapshot, VeUser, VeUserLockDelta), plus Block,
GaugeState and Harvest, are absent from that deployment. Per-chain schema
files are what keep those out of the run rather than aborting on them.
The 7 PreMining* types exist in the merged schema but in NO helper subgraph,
so they have no reference to compare against on any chain.
